name: Gerald
tagline: Reliably average. Has never let anyone down, mostly because he has never done anything.
description: Recovered from a riverbank, where he had been lying for some time. Gerald is grey on every side, which our curators describe as consistent. He fits in a pocket and makes no demands.

name: Boulderina
tagline: Exactly two kilograms. And she knows it.
description: Weighed three times to confirm: exactly 2000 grams. Collected from a quarry, where she was the only stone that met our standards. Handle with both hands and appropriate respect.

name: Heart-Shaped-Ish
tagline: Heart-shaped if you squint and really want it to be.
description: Found on a hiking trail by a collector who very much wanted to find a heart-shaped rock. The pink granite is genuine; the heart is a matter of interpretation. A thoughtful gift for people who appreciate effort.

name: Pocket Worry Stone
description: A smooth piece of slate from a lake shore, sized for a thumb. Rub it when anxious. Results are not documented, but the stone has never complained.

name: The Classic Stick
tagline: The stick your dog dreams about.
description: An oak stick of the kind every dog recognises at once. Selected in a park for its length, balance and general throwability. Bark partially intact.

name: Suspiciously Straight Stick
description: Collected in a forest, where sticks are rarely this straight. We measured it, and it is straight. We do not know why, and we have stopped asking.

name: The Log
description: A section of birch log, 40 centimetres long and fully committed to being a log. It does not roll unless provoked. It will stay exactly where you put it, for years.

name: Single Blade of Grass
tagline: Hand-picked. From a lawn. Our lawn.
description: A single blade of grass, selected from a lawn of several million candidates. It registers as 0 grams on our scales. Supplied flat, green and ready to be admired.
imageAlt: Photo of Single Blade of Grass

name: Autumn Leaf
description: A maple leaf collected at the height of its colour. It has since dried slightly and become more confident. Do not fold.

name: Very Normal Feather
tagline: Previous owner unknown. Probably a pigeon.
description: Found in a city square and attributed to a pigeon, although no pigeon has come forward. Grey-white, lightweight and very normal. Flight not included.

name: Acorn
tagline: A future oak with no immediate plans.
description: An acorn in excellent condition, cap attached. In theory it contains an entire oak tree. In practice it has shown no interest in becoming one.

name: Premium Sand
tagline: Too many grains to count. We tried.
description: Five hundred grams of beach sand, sifted once for dignity. Grain count unknown; we started counting and lost our place. Supplied as a neat heap.
